instruction: Search for a one way flight from Berlin to Dublin on 10th next month for 3 adults on Ryanair.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully searched for a one-way flight from Dublin to Vienna on 10th next month for 2 adults on Ryanair. Accepted cookies, selected one-way, set origin/destination airports, date, passengers, and clicked search to reach flight results.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Ryanair website, handle cookie dialogs, select one-way trips, change origin/destination airports via country/airport picker, set travel dates, modify passenger counts, and submit flight search
metadata.task_rationale: Same flight search pattern but reversed direction (Berlin to Dublin instead of Dublin to Vienna), different date (10th), and more passengers (3 adults). Tests ability to handle a different European route with higher passenger count.
metadata.explanation: Task requires searching Ryanair for a one-way Berlin to Dublin flight on 10th next month with 3 adults. Evaluator parses URL parameters to verify origin/destination IATA codes (BER/DUB), passenger counts, date, and trip type. [Fixed: changed relativeTime from '11th next month' to '10th next month' because '11th next month' has no handler in the single-time path of get_rule_relativeTime - only '5th next month' and '10th next month' are supported there]
fix_history: Fix 1: Changed relativeTime from '20th next month' to '12th next month' (incorrect - '12th next month' also not supported).
Fix 2: Changed relativeTime from '12th next month' to '11th next month' (incorrect - '11th next month' exists in relativeTime_to_IntDay but has no handler in single-time path).
Fix 3: Changed relativeTime from '11th next month' to '10th next month' which has a working handler in the single-time path of get_rule_relativeTime. Updated instruction text to match.

llm_judge_reasons: The previous critical issue has been fixed: relativeTime 'from' is now '10th next month', which has a working handler in the single-time path of get_rule_relativeTime (misc.py lines 146-151). The date will be correctly resolved to an absolute date.

Getter active_tab_url_parse correctly parses Ryanair URL query parameters (originIata, destinationIata, tpAdults, tpTeens, tpChildren, tpStartDate, isReturn) and the replace mapping renames tpStartDate to 'time' to match the expected key.

Expected values are semantically correct: BER (Berlin) and DUB (Dublin) are the correct IATA codes, tpAdults='3' matches '3 adults', tpTeens='0' and tpChildren='0' are correct defaults, isReturn='false' correctly verifies one-way trip.
Date template '{Year}-{Month0D}-{DayD}' will produce format like '2026-03-10' which matches Ryanair's tpStartDate URL parameter format.

Metric check_direct_json_object correctly compares each key-value pair from the expected JSON against the parsed URL parameters. All instruction requirements (route, passengers, date, one-way) are fully covered.
validation.fix_applied: Changed relativeTime from '11th next month' to '10th next month' which has a working handler in the single-time path of get_rule_relativeTime. Updated instruction to match.
